svg.title: SimpleCNN for Pizza, Steak and Sushi
svg.desc: RGB input, Conv 16, ReLU, Pool, Conv 32, ReLU, Pool, Flatten 8192, MLP hidden Linear 128, ReLU, and output Linear to 3 logits. Feature maps are schematic.
svg.text: How our CNN reads a food photo
SimpleCNN | Pizza / Steak / Sushi | Input size: 64 × 64
Channels and H/W stay the same.
SHAPES: channels × height × width; batch dimension omitted. Feature-map textures and stack depth are schematic.
TRAIN: logits → CrossEntropyLoss | PREDICT CLASS: argmax(logits) | DISPLAY PROBABILITIES: softmax(logits)
